svg.text: VLA v533 — one clock tick (40 ms): one recurrent CNN layer, its EMA register written through a learned gate

n_hidden 512 · c_context 384 · 7×7 grid · depth 8 · 3 token streams · 25 Hz · EMA (16 ticks to start) + copy, RMSnorm reads · reset at each example · 20.5M trainable · state 2 × 512×7×7 = 50,176 values
each stream's sample → its next input (training: the dataset's)
an EMA at a learned rate a
A 1×1 conv on the working state h sets DFF_1's write rate for each of
its 512 channels at each of the 49 positions, every tick. It starts at
the fixed rate 1/16 (weights 0, bias −log 15): the model it was added to.
The copy register needs no rate; it holds whatever the EMA did not.
Trained: SGD, lr 0.001, Nesterov momentum 0.95 · BPTT 64 ticks · gate at 100× lr.
One layer: v522's second layer dropped (it never used its registers).
RMS norm (per sample, per position) · replicate
write gate: conv 1×1 + sigmoid → rate a
(−) subtractor: x minus the EMA as just written
D flip-flop register, clocked every tick
